commit_message:
feat(theme): add Rainbow Unicorns pastel theme

New optional theme entry in THEMES map: pastel purple/pink palette for UI variables and matching xterm terminal color set. No changes to theme selection logic or DEFAULT_THEME.

Confidence: high
Scope-risk: narrow
Not-tested: visual rendering of new theme not checked in browser

historical.message:
feat(theme): add Rainbow Unicorns pastel light theme

Add a fifth theme, unicorn ("Rainbow Unicorns (Pastel)"), to the THEMES
map in public/theme.js: pale lavender-pink surfaces, pink accent, and
rainbow state colors that keep the established semantics (running green,
waiting amber, failed red, starting violet, complete fuchsia). Second
light theme after Compleated; terminal palette uses darkened ANSI tones
for light-background legibility. Settings dialog picks it up via
getThemeList() with no other changes.

All accent, state, and muted-text colors verified at or above 4.5:1 WCAG
AA contrast against their backgrounds after review flagged the initial
draft values.

Confidence: high
Scope-risk: narrow
Not-tested: visual appearance in a live browser session
